title: Why Do Ads Want Your Attention?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Ads Want Your Attention.
Ads are designed to tug eyes and feelings.
Let me show you that in 3D.
You can notice the tug and keep walking.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
You are more than a customer.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
The pictures today are a new book world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do ads want your attention.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
